hq.description: Appends the specified query terms to the query, as if they were combined with a logical AND operator.

filter.description: Controls turning on or off the duplicate content filter. * See [Automatic Filtering](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#automaticFiltering) for more information about Google's search results filters. imgDominantColor.description: Returns images of a specific dominant color. Acceptable values are: * `"black"` * `"blue"` * `"brown"` * `"gray"` * `"green"` * `"orange"` * `"pink"` * `"purple"` * `"red"` * `"teal"` * `"white"` * `"yellow"`
